integrity: The proof is symbolic and independent of the finite checker. Exact-integer exhaustive tests through valuation 25 and a replay of the Reyssat example are supplied only as consistency checks. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem prunes the exact degree search for the real enhanced-radical objective only. It does not solve the separate p-adic or combined-gain optimizations, identify a globally extremal abc-triple, or claim the universal candidate-count bound is sharp.
title: Quotient-breakpoint reduction for minimizing real enhanced radicals
